description: Conversion of garage into habitable room and alterations to front elevation.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (BL/DRG/260919/04(Rev.B) [received on 20 January 2020], BL/DRG/260919/02 [received on 20 November 2019], and BL/DRG/260919/01 and BL/DRG/260919/03 [received on 12 November 2019]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The habitable room hereby permitted shall be used incidental to the use of 24 Manor Gardens, W3 8JU, and not as a self-contained dwelling unit nor for business purposes.
